phone.busy: Wait for the answer on screen to finish first.
phone.cutShort: The answer was cut short. Try again.
phone.failed: Could not finish on this phone. Try again.
phone.interrupted: The app closed before this finished. Tap Try again to finish it.
phone.network: No internet connection. Reconnect, then try again.
phone.notIncluded: Your plan does not include this. Pick another account or model.
phone.outOfCredit: This account is out of credit. Add credit, then try again.
phone.rateLimited: This account has reached its limit for now. Try again later.
phone.resting: The model is busy right now. Try again in a few minutes.
phone.signedOut: This account is signed out on this phone. Sign in again to keep going.
phone.stepLimit: This needs too many steps for the phone. Try a smaller request.
